friendly_name: Pack doctrine artefacts: directive, styleguide, paradigm
purpose_context: The charter service models only the tactic artefact as a rich pack entity today; the other doctrine artefacts are read as generic facts. This mission gives the three prose doctrine artefacts (directive, styleguide, paradigm) the same first-class treatment as the tactic — typed identity, invariants, storage round-trip and repository access — so the service can read and write them faithfully, continuing the packs slice without touching the harder asset, profile and mission-type tiers.
purpose_tldr: Model the directive, styleguide and paradigm charter artefacts as first-class pack entities that survive a YAML round trip.
contracts_rationale: This mission models existing canonical pack-artefact shapes (directive/styleguide/paradigm) as domain entities with YAML round-trip; it defines no new service interface or API surface. The authoritative schemas it validates against are the vendored contracts/packs/schemas/*.schema.json (ADR-0017), unchanged here.
